verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms a real llms.txt at developer.brex.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with a structured table of contents for the Brex Developer API. Docs pages are also served as agent-friendly markdown (.md) variants, such as index.html.md, docs/mcp.md and openapi/webhooks_api.md. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming these docs, evidence of how complete the llms.txt is beyond its truncated table of contents (e.g. an llms-full.txt).
